issues: The cemetery retrieval should be optional ('select up to 1'); encode the last step as an optional cemetery tutor rather than a mandatory tutorFromCemetery to hand.

The fanfare buff is incorrectly encoded as def equal to this follower's defense; it should give this follower [defense]+X where X equals the number of other followers with Ward on your field. This requires a dynamic amount for counting field followers by keyword/keyword-with-exclude-self, which is not implemented; add a DamageAmount/selector for counting allied followers with a given keyword (excluding self) and use that in buffDynamic.
Fanfare should not be listed in keywords; keep the fanfare ability only and remove 'fanfare' from keywords.

The second choice is missing the Earth Rite condition/cost; encode option 2 so it only resolves with Earth Rite (1), e.g. using an if/removeCounter style Earth Rite implementation before dealing 3 damage.

The paid fanfare is incorrectly represented with an ability cost field on timing 'fanfare'; it should be an optional additional [cost03] tied to the fanfare that, if paid, gives each follower with Ward on your field +1/+2. The buff target is also incorrect: trait 'Ward' is not a trait filter. This needs engine support for optional additional PP payment on triggered abilities and for buffing followers by keyword (Ward) rather than trait; implement support for optional fanfare extra costs and keyword-based field filtering, then encode the conditional buff correctly.

The fanfare should let you add any number of matching cards from among the top 5, but searchDeckChoose only selects a single card; encode a multi-select top-5 reveal/add-to-hand effect for any number of Dragoncraft cards costing 7 or more, then put the rest on the bottom. This requires an implemented operation for searching a looked-at subset and choosing any number of matches.

The start-of-end ability is incomplete; after dealing 4 damage to the selected enemy follower, it should also deal 2 damage to that follower's leader. Encode this with damageFollowerAndLeader or an equivalent sequence that includes both damages.
